beats.action: After an ordinary 3–4-line serious Shreya team handover, Shreya meets Keshav (Station Chotu, age 23), whom she already knows from the previous day's strong-chai counter exchange. Station office-support tasks need coverage. She asks whether he is willing to add scheduled basic administrative support—delivering authorized sealed packets, blank forms, outward dispatch slips, and tea to her cabin—without replacing his tea-counter responsibilities. Keshav clearly agrees. Shreya arranges the assignment through the existing station duty/admin schedule; no special unfounded police rank, unrestricted case-file access, extra character, or overtime assumed. He does not read evidence or confidential case contents. This makes future brief solo cabin deliveries natural, not staged. Professional interaction only; no teasing, flirting, touch, accidents or deliberate display yet.

beats.limits: No kissing, explicit exposure, genital/breast touching or new promise.

scenes.title: Clinical work, quiet memory without invented accident

beats.title: Known colleague, unresolved Jan1 Naveen handoff
beats.action: Naveen is an established hospital assistant. January 1 14:15 interaction remains an unresolved earlier cutpoint; neither an accident nor any hidden intimacy from it is invented.

scenes.title: M08 — shifted senior review remains fixed

beats.action: The user-shifted M08 senior review goes from 11:00 to 11:40. It is not replaced by Chotu flirting or another medically implausible scene.

beats.action: Naveen hands off approved review documents and wellness records, without a falling binder, missing page or fake emergency. She notices his attentive presence while checking the document dates.

beats.action: Their routine conversation leaves Meenakshi wondering why she wants his attention outside the work he performs; she does not use senior clinical authority to obtain it.

beats.action: Meenakshi finishes clinical duties, with Vihaan's childcare arranged offstage in ordinary family care. The abandoned Jan2 car-seat rivalry, Babloo hatch, repeated twin flirting and first-aid hand demonstration are NOT revived.

scenes.location: Hospital private staff changing → non-clinical administrative reception

beats.title: Independent wardrobe choice
beats.action: After clinical duty Meenakshi dresses in her own selected sari with a deep neckline, bare midriff and upper back, while preserving normal changing-room privacy. Her sari-pallu drape is deliberately chosen; it is not accidentally pulled aside.

beats.title: A personal question, outside patient care
beats.action: Meenakshi sees Naveen during final wellness paperwork at the nonclinical reception and chooses to ask if he is comfortable with a private, clearly personal moment. His reaction surprises her precisely because she intended to notice it.

beats.title: Mutually agreed waist embrace
beats.action: If Naveen freely accepts the contact, she invites a single close waist embrace; it ends as soon as she releases him. This is her deliberately chosen gesture, not a nurse demonstration, duty-related touch, or proof of later consent.
beats.limits: No kiss; no patient spectators; no senior-pressure dynamic; no explicit exposure.

beats.title: End without invented crossover
beats.action: She turns back toward Vihaan and Nikhil's household routine, privately surprised by the intentional choice she made; no Babloo society accident, twins, or work-related consequence is invented as a fact.

secondaryEncounters.title: Aditi and Avi: their existing playful rapport

secondaryEncounters.title: Meenakshi and Avi: the new question

beats.title: Flirtation without repeated touch

beats.physical: No repeat waist/abdomen touching or intentional wardrobe slip.

beats.action: Yash notices that Rupa has stayed late to get the list right; Rupa replies that she values people who can be attentive without being loud. Yash smiles and offers to bring her tea during the next genuine break, and she says she might take him up on it.
